lessons.titleEn: the water young people swim in
lessons.titleZh: 包圍日常的網絡媒體環境

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Online media is the water young people swim in.
sources.expression: the water young people swim in

brief.meaningEn: An extensively surrounding environment of everyday experience, here digital media in young people’s lives.
brief.meaningZh: 廣泛包圍日常經驗的環境，這裏指年輕人生活中的網絡媒體。
brief.grammar: online media is the water young people swim in; water is an environment image rather than one isolated activity. The context must establish how widespread that environment is.
brief.boundaryZh: 不表示每人每刻都在網上，也不抹去家庭、學校或線下活動；廣泛環境仍包含個人選擇與差異。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不表示每人每刻都在網上，也不抹去家庭、學校或線下活動；廣泛環境仍包含個人選擇與差異。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「包圍日常的網絡媒體環境」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: An extended environment metaphor, not a literal statement or a universal quantitative finding about screen use.

listening.en: The diary presents online media as the water young people swim in: messages connect school plans, friendships and hobbies, even when the activities themselves happen away from the screen.
listening.zh: 日記把網絡媒體寫成年輕人身處的日常環境：訊息連起學校計劃、友誼與興趣，即使活動本身在螢幕之外進行。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 媒體廣泛連起日常安排，並不排除線下活動。
日記說所有興趣都只在網上進行，沒有線下活動。
日記只記一次偶然登入，沒有日常連結。
訊息只在課外興趣中使用，學校計劃和友誼沒有透過它聯繫。

listening.explanationZh: connect plans/friendships/hobbies 給廣泛環境，even away screen 保留線下活動。

reply.promptEn: What does the water image convey in the diary?
reply.promptZh: 日記的水的圖像傳達甚麼？

options.en: Online media is the water young people swim in because it surrounds and connects many ordinary activities.
options.zh: 網絡媒體是年輕人身處的日常環境，因它包圍並連起很多平常活動。

options.en: It is more than a single occasional task in the account.
options.zh: 在敘述中，它不只是偶爾的一項任務。

options.en: The image places media around everyday plans and relationships.
options.zh: 圖像把媒體放在日常計劃與關係周圍。

options.en: It describes a surrounding context while leaving room for activities away from the screen.
options.zh: 它描述包圍生活的背景，也保留螢幕以外的活動。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一份日記只記一次偶然登入查地址，沒有其他網絡活動或跨生活連結資料。評論想由此概括網絡媒體已包圍此人的全部日常。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: One occasional login alone does not establish the water young people swim in as a broad description of this person’s daily environment.
options.zh: 單是一次偶然登入，不足以把「年輕人身處的媒體環境」確立為此人廣泛日常的描述。

options.en: The diary records daily connections between school plans, friendships and hobbies through messages.
options.zh: 日記記錄了每天透過訊息連起學校安排、友誼和興趣。

options.en: The fact that the person checked one address identifies online media as the main setting for the rest of that day.
options.zh: 人物查過一個地址，就足以確定網絡媒體是當天其餘活動的主要環境。

scene.explanationZh: 偶然一次使用與廣泛連起日常不同；不能把未給的其他活動補成已記錄。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 the water young people swim in 的媒體圖像得出？

options.en: 媒體可能廣泛包圍日常經驗。
每個人每一刻都只在網上生活。
仍需了解各人怎樣使用及有哪些線下關係。

contrast.explanationZh: 包圍的環境不是所有時間與所有人的量化宣告。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說既在網絡環境中成長，球隊見面就不算生活重要部分；你想解釋互相連結。哪句最好？

options.en: The water young people swim in includes communication around offline life; arranging a match online does not make the meeting itself unimportant.
options.zh: 年輕人身處的媒體環境，包括圍繞線下生活的溝通；網上約比賽不會令實際見面不重要。

options.en: I thought describing an online environment meant the face-to-face parts should be left out of the diary.
options.zh: 我原以為描述網絡環境，就應不寫日記裏面對面的部分。

options.en: I would count only what happens on the device, not the activities the messages help organise.
options.zh: 我只會計算裝置上發生甚麼，不看訊息幫忙安排的活動。

dialogue.explanationZh: 環境圖像可包含媒介與活動的關係，不是排除線下經驗。

speaking.en: In the students’ diary, online media is the water young people swim in, linking the football plans with conversations that continue after the match.
speaking.zh: 在學生的日記裏，網絡媒體是年輕人身處的日常環境，連起足球計劃和賽後繼續的談話。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分包圍生活的環境與每項活動的場地。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們設計媒體日記表，現有草稿只問每日用了多少分鐘。你想加一欄，讓學生記一件訊息怎樣幫忙安排線下活動，了解環境與生活的連結，不預設每人相同。用一至兩句英文向研究伙伴提議問題。

examples.en: If online media is the water young people swim in, counting minutes alone may miss how it connects activities. Could the diary ask for one example of a message that helped organise an offline plan, alongside the time record?
examples.zh: 如果網絡媒體是年輕人身處的日常環境，只計分鐘可能漏掉它怎樣連起活動。日記除記時間外，可否問一個訊息幫忙安排線下計劃的例子？

examples.en: To explore the water young people swim in, I suggest a column linking one message with what happened away from the screen. That would let students describe their own pattern rather than fit a single assumption about online life.
examples.zh: 要了解年輕人身處的媒體環境，我建議加一欄，把一則訊息跟螢幕外發生的事連起來。那讓學生描述自己的模式，不必配合對網絡生活的單一假定。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把環境圖像轉成可回答的具體記錄問題，連到線下生活並保留差異；不只重述圖像，也不預先填好所有人的經驗。

takeaways.en: Her essay calls group messaging the water young people swim in because it links the clubs, journeys and friendships described across the week.
takeaways.zh: 她的文章把群組訊息稱為年輕人身處的日常環境，因它連起一周的學會、旅程與友誼。

takeaways.en: The water young people swim in is not the whole story in the interview; the speaker also describes how family conversations shape the use of media.
takeaways.zh: 訪問裏，年輕人身處的媒體環境不是全部故事；說話者也描述家庭談話怎樣影響媒體使用。

lessons.titleEn: the screen does not simply reflect their world
lessons.titleZh: 螢幕不只反映，也參與塑造世界觀

target.pattern: \bthe screen does not simply reflect their world\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: For children, the screen does not simply reflect their world.
sources.expression: the screen does not simply reflect their world

brief.meaningEn: Media selection and presentation can shape how people understand their world, as well as show parts of it.
brief.meaningZh: 媒體的選擇與呈現，不只展示世界的一部分，也可塑造人怎樣理解世界。
brief.grammar: for these readers/children, the screen does not simply reflect their world; establish whose world their refers to. Not simply allows reflection while adding shaping influence.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是說所有影像都虛假，也不是看見甚麼就必然照做；要看選擇、排序或呈現怎樣影響理解。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說所有影像都虛假，也不是看見甚麼就必然照做；要看選擇、排序或呈現怎樣影響理解。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「螢幕不只反映，也參與塑造世界觀」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: A reflective-screen metaphor with an explicit not-only contrast, related to self-image mirrors but extending to views of the wider world.

listening.en: For the pupils in the story, the screen does not simply reflect their world: showing only competitions on the school page changes which achievements they notice and discuss.
listening.zh: 對故事裏的學生，螢幕不只反映他們的世界：校網只展示比賽，改變了他們留意及談論哪些成就。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 選擇展示哪些內容，參與塑造學生留意的成就。
所有比賽照片都已被證明捏造，所以學生沒真實活動。
校網已同樣呈現每種成就，沒有內容選擇。
學生仍只按親身參加的活動評價成就，校網展示沒有影響他們留意的事。

listening.explanationZh: showing only/changes notice 說選擇性與影響，不需所有照片虛假。

reply.promptEn: How does the school page affect the pupils’ view?
reply.promptZh: 校網怎樣影響學生的看法？

options.en: The screen does not simply reflect their world; its selection helps shape which achievements they notice.
options.zh: 螢幕不只反映他們的世界；選擇內容也塑造他們留意哪些成就。

options.en: The repeated focus on competitions makes one kind of success more visible in discussion.
options.zh: 反覆聚焦比賽，讓一種成功在討論中更顯眼。

options.en: The page presents a selected part of school life, which affects what they talk about.
options.zh: 頁面呈現校園生活選出的一部分，影響他們談甚麼。

options.en: The pupils are responding to a framing of events, not an unselected view of everything at school.
options.zh: 學生回應的是有框架的事件呈現，不是學校一切未經選擇的全景。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 兩個頁面用相同真實活動照片，一個先放獎項，另一個先放合作過程；學生談論重點因而不同。有人說沒假照片就不可能影響理解。哪句最好？

options.en: For these pupils, the screen does not simply reflect their world; the different ordering can shape emphasis even when the images are real.
options.zh: 對這些學生，螢幕不只反映他們的世界；即使影像真實，不同排序也可塑造重點。

options.en: The account says the photographs were fabricated rather than ordered differently.
options.zh: 敘述說照片被捏造，而不是排序不同。

options.en: Using real photographs establishes that the order cannot affect what pupils notice.
options.zh: 用真照片，足以確立排序不能影響學生留意甚麼。

scene.explanationZh: 呈現方式也可影響理解，不只真假一項。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 the screen does not simply reflect their world 得出？

options.en: 媒體可透過選擇與呈現參與塑造看法。
凡出現在螢幕上的內容都必然是假的。
仍可承認有真實影像，同時檢查框架。

contrast.explanationZh: not simply 不是完全否認反映，而是加上塑造作用。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說圖片真實，就不用問為甚麼只選某類；你想談呈現的作用。哪句最好？

options.en: The screen does not simply reflect their world; even real images can leave a selective impression when we choose only one type of activity.
options.zh: 螢幕不只反映他們的世界；即使是真圖，只選一類活動也可留下選擇性的印象。

options.en: I thought a factual image made the selection and order irrelevant to how readers understood the page.
options.zh: 我原以為圖片真實，選擇和排序就跟讀者怎樣理解無關。

options.en: I would check only whether each photo is genuine, not what the chosen set leaves out.
options.zh: 我只會查每張是否真實，不看選出那組漏了甚麼。

dialogue.explanationZh: 真假重要，但沒有涵蓋選擇與遺漏全部問題。

speaking.en: For these readers, the screen does not simply reflect their world; our choice of examples helps decide which parts become visible.
speaking.zh: 對這些讀者，螢幕不只反映他們的世界；我們選的例子有助決定哪些部分可見。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說選例與可見範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們想研究校網展示是否改變學生對「重要成就」的看法，但現在只有看完頁面後的答案。你要向研究伙伴提議，下次先請願意參與的學生私下寫下原有看法，再看頁面及比較後答；不要把現有資料說成已證明因果。用一至兩句英文提出資料收集方式。

examples.en: The screen does not simply reflect their world, but our current answers cannot show how the students’ views changed. Could we ask willing participants about their priorities before viewing the page, then compare their later responses?
examples.zh: 螢幕不只反映他們的世界，但目前答案不能顯示學生看法怎樣改變。我們可否先問願意參與者看頁面前重視甚麼，再比較後來回覆？

examples.en: To investigate how the screen does not simply reflect their world, I suggest collecting the students’ earlier views as well as their later answers. We should compare those responses before claiming the page changed what they consider important.
examples.zh: 要研究螢幕怎樣不只反映他們的世界，我建議同時收集學生先前看法與後來答案。聲稱頁面改變他們重視甚麼前，我們應先比較那些回覆。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出先後觀點比較的具體資料安排，保留自願；不把一次後答當已證明改變，也不保證兩次比較就排除所有其他原因。

takeaways.en: For the characters, the screen does not simply reflect their world; the repeated rankings change how they describe an ordinary achievement.
takeaways.zh: 對角色而言，螢幕不只反映他們的世界；反覆排名改變他們怎樣描述平常成就。

takeaways.en: For the students, the screen does not simply reflect their world when they see a neighbourhood only through a narrow selection of stories.
takeaways.zh: 學生只透過很窄的故事選擇認識一個社區時，螢幕不只反映他們的世界。

lessons.titleZh: 在不顯眼的引導下逐漸作選擇

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Their choices are being nudged along by recommendations.

brief.meaningEn: Being subtly encouraged or directed towards a choice or course, rather than necessarily forced.
brief.meaningZh: 受到不顯眼的鼓勵或牽引而朝某種選擇前進，不一定是被強迫。
brief.grammar: choices are being nudged along by recommendations; someone is being nudged along towards an option. The passive names an influence acting during the process.
brief.boundaryZh: 輕推不等於強迫，也不單憑最後結果確定原因；需有推薦、排序或提示等實際作用線索。
brief.misconceptionZh: 輕推不等於強迫，也不單憑最後結果確定原因；需有推薦、排序或提示等實際作用線索。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「在不顯眼的引導下逐漸作選擇」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Her playlist choices were being nudged along by the repeated recommendations at the top of the page; she still chose the tracks, but some options were made much easier to notice than others.
listening.zh: 頁首反覆推薦的內容，正輕推她的播放清單選擇；歌曲仍由她選，但有些選項比其他更易被看見。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 推薦影響可見選項，她仍參與選擇。
平台已強制播放所有歌曲，她沒有選任何曲目。
頁面完全沒有推薦或排序，她只從自己的紙本清單選。
她已確認每首歌曲都因相同原因獲選，沒有其他偏好。

listening.explanationZh: recommendations/top/easier notice 說輕推機制，still chose 保留自主，不是強迫。

reply.promptEn: How did the recommendations affect her choices?
reply.promptZh: 推薦怎樣影響她的選擇？

options.en: Her choices were being nudged along by what the page made easiest to notice.
options.zh: 頁面把甚麼放得最易看見，正輕推她的選擇。

options.en: The repeated suggestions increased the visibility of some tracks.
options.zh: 反覆建議增加了某些歌曲的可見度。

options.en: She chose for herself within a display that drew her attention unevenly.
options.zh: 她自行選擇，但展示對不同選項的注意引導不平均。

options.en: The influence was in presentation and repetition, not a command removing every choice.
options.zh: 影響在於呈現與重複，不是取消每項選擇的命令。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 參加者從自己帶來的手寫清單選活動，當時沒有看到網站推薦。報告只因選了熱門項目，就確定是推薦推動。哪句較謹慎？

options.en: The popular result alone does not show the choice being nudged along by recommendations the person did not see.
options.zh: 單是結果熱門，不能顯示選擇受到本人未看過的推薦輕推。

options.en: The account gives repeated exposure to the website recommendations before the selection.
options.zh: 敘述交代選擇前反覆看過網站推薦。

options.en: Choosing a popular activity establishes that the participant had been shown it first on the website.
options.zh: 選熱門活動，足以確立網站先展示過它給參加者。

scene.explanationZh: 需有實際接觸與作用線索，不由結果倒推未見過的推薦。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 being nudged along 得出？

options.en: 可能有不顯眼的鼓勵或牽引。
當事人一定完全不能自己選擇。
仍可問由甚麼提示、排序或推薦形成作用。

contrast.explanationZh: nudge 的輕推與強迫不同，仍需看具體程度。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說既是她自己按選歌，就不可能受推薦影響；你想說選擇環境的作用。哪句最好？

options.en: She can choose and still be influenced; being nudged along can mean some tracks are repeatedly put in front of her.
options.zh: 她可以自行選，也仍受影響；受到輕推可指某些歌曲反覆被放到眼前。

options.en: I thought a choice counted as influenced only if the page prevented every alternative.
options.zh: 我原以為只有頁面阻止所有其他選項，才算受影響。

options.en: I would compare only the final tracks, not the recommendations she saw before selecting them.
options.zh: 我只會比較最後歌曲，不看她選前看過的推薦。

dialogue.explanationZh: 自主與輕推可並存，實際看過甚麼比只看結果更能理解過程。

speaking.en: I wonder whether our choice of route is being nudged along by the card order, so I want to compare the full list before deciding.
speaking.zh: 我想路線選擇是否正受卡片次序輕推，所以想在決定前比較完整清單。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說觀察到的提示與要作的比較。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：展覽網站首頁只挑選部分推薦活動，標題卻寫「全部活動」。你想請編輯改標題並另放完整清單連結，讓訪客知道自己看的是被選過的集合；你不從這點便斷定每個人的選擇都被控制。用一至兩句英文提出介面文字修改及理由。

examples.en: Could we label this panel ‘selected suggestions’ and provide a separate link to all events? That would help visitors notice whether their choices are being nudged along by the limited set we show first.
examples.zh: 這欄可否標作「精選建議」，另提供全部活動連結？那會幫訪客留意自己的選擇是否正被我們首先展示的有限集合輕推。

examples.en: If visitors’ choices are being nudged along by our selected cards, ‘all events’ is the wrong label for this panel. I suggest ‘our suggestions’, with a separate route to the full list, so the scope is clear.
examples.zh: 如果訪客選擇正被我們選出的卡片輕推，「全部活動」就不是這欄的正確標題。我建議改為「我們的建議」，另有完整清單入口，讓範圍清楚。

writing.selfCheckZh: 對已知的精選集合提出準確標題與完整入口，讓引導方式可辨認；不把它冒充全部選項，也不因呈現有選擇便斷言每人都被強迫。

takeaways.en: The group’s choice was being nudged along by the examples printed largest on the poster before anyone compared the remaining options.
takeaways.zh: 大家比較餘下選項前，海報印得最大的例子正輕推小組選擇。

takeaways.en: She wondered whether the discussion was being nudged along by the chair’s repeated examples, and asked to hear another kind of case.
takeaways.zh: 她想討論是否正被主席反覆舉的例子輕推，並要求聽另一類個案。

lessons.titleZh: 可信朋友的意見可比許多網上聲音更有分量

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A trusted friend can outweigh a hundred online voices.

brief.meaningEn: Matter more in a particular judgement than many opinions encountered online, using an exaggerated weight comparison.
brief.meaningZh: 在某次判斷中，比網上眾多意見更有分量，以誇張重量對比表達。
brief.grammar: a trusted friend can outweigh a hundred online voices; hundred is rhetorical scale, not necessarily a counted survey. Explain why this input is relevant rather than rank by friendship alone.
brief.boundaryZh: 不保證朋友總是正確，也不是所有網上意見都無用；應看具體了解、理由與證據，不只身份或聲量。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不保證朋友總是正確，也不是所有網上意見都無用；應看具體了解、理由與證據，不只身份或聲量。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「可信朋友的意見可比許多網上聲音更有分量」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: A trusted friend can outweigh a hundred online voices when she knows the commitments behind my choice and asks the question the general advice has missed; I still need to judge the reasons myself.
listening.zh: 可信朋友了解我選擇背後的承諾，又提出一般建議漏掉的問題時，她的意見可比許多網上聲音更有分量；我仍需自己判斷理由。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 朋友的具體了解可有重要分量，最後仍需判斷理由。
只因是朋友，她在每件事上的結論都已獲證明。
說話者只按意見數量判斷，認為較多人支持的一方較可信。
朋友不了解承諾，只重複同一份一般建議。

listening.explanationZh: when knows/question/reasons 說明相關了解的價值；can 保留可能，a hundred 是誇張數量，並非按票數決定。

reply.promptEn: Why might that friend’s advice matter more in this decision?
reply.promptZh: 那位朋友的建議為甚麼可能在這次決定更有分量？

options.en: She can outweigh a hundred online voices because she knows the commitments the general advice overlooks.
options.zh: 她知道一般建議漏看的承諾，所以意見可比許多網上聲音更有分量。

options.en: Her question connects with the actual circumstances rather than only a common rule.
options.zh: 她的問題連到實際情況，不只常見規則。

options.en: She knows relevant details that were missing from the broad advice.
options.zh: 她知道籠統建議缺少的相關細節。

options.en: The value is in the informed reason she offers, while I still have to consider it.
options.zh: 價值在於她在了解情況後提出的理由，而我仍需要考慮。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 朋友不了解人物的工作安排，只重複網上常見說法。人物想只因「是我朋友」便給她更高權威。哪句較謹慎？

options.en: A friend does not outweigh a hundred online voices by identity alone; this account still needs a relevant reason or better understanding.
options.zh: 朋友不會只因身份就比許多網上聲音更有分量；這裏仍需相關理由或更好的了解。

options.en: The account says the friend has examined the commitments that the general advice missed.
options.zh: 敘述說朋友已檢視一般建議漏看的承諾。

options.en: Repeating the common rule is described as providing new knowledge of the person’s circumstances.
options.zh: 重複常見規則，被描述為提供對人物情況的新了解。

scene.explanationZh: 看理由與了解，不讓朋友身份代替證據；題目未給新細節。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 can outweigh a hundred online voices 得出？

options.en: 某次有根據的意見可能比很多其他意見更重要。
朋友的意見在所有情況都必定正確。
誇張數量不一定是逐人計數。

contrast.explanationZh: can 與特定理由不構成朋友永遠正確的定律。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說你既相信她，就不應再問理由；你想保留信任與判斷。哪句最好？

options.en: Your view can outweigh a hundred online voices when it addresses what they miss, but understanding your reasons is part of taking it seriously.
options.zh: 你的看法回應別人漏看的事時，可比許多網上聲音更有分量，但理解理由正是認真看待的一部分。

options.en: I thought trust meant the explanation was unnecessary even when the choice affected commitments you did not know about.
options.zh: 我原以為信任就表示不用解釋，即使選擇影響你未知道的承諾。

options.en: I would decide only by how many people gave each answer, without comparing what they understood.
options.zh: 我只會按各答案有多少人支持決定，不比較他們了解甚麼。

dialogue.explanationZh: 信任不排除理由，數量也不代替對具體情況的理解。

speaking.en: One careful comment can outweigh a hundred online voices when it identifies a detail the rest of the discussion has ignored.
speaking.zh: 一個仔細評語指出其餘討論漏掉的細節時，可以比許多網上聲音更有分量。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再交代分量來自甚麼相關理由。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你收到很多網上讚好的初稿，朋友卻仔細指出時間線有矛盾，並圈出兩處。你想寫訊息感謝她具體核讀，說這種回饋對修稿比泛泛讚好更有幫助，但仍會核對她指出的地方，不把朋友身份當真確證明。用一至兩句英文回應。

examples.en: Your careful note can outweigh a hundred online voices for this revision because it shows the two passages that may conflict. Thank you for reading closely; I will check those dates rather than rely on the general praise alone.
examples.zh: 你仔細的筆記指出可能衝突的兩段，對這次修稿可比許多網上聲音更有分量。謝謝你細讀；我會查那些日期，不只依賴籠統讚好。

examples.en: A comment grounded in the text can outweigh a hundred online voices, and your marked passages give me something specific to examine. I appreciate that work, even as I go back to verify the timeline myself.
examples.zh: 有文本依據的評語可比許多網上聲音更有分量，你圈出的段落給我具體可查之處。我感謝那份工作，也會自己回去核對時間線。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以具體可核讀的回饋表達感謝，保留自己核對的下一步；不只按朋友身份或讚好數量判準確，也不把誇張數量當調查結果。

takeaways.en: Her brother’s informed question could outweigh a hundred online voices because it revealed a practical condition the popular advice had not considered.
takeaways.zh: 哥哥有了解的提問揭示流行建議未考慮的實際條件，因此可比許多網上聲音更有分量。

takeaways.en: The editor said a precise correction could outweigh a hundred online voices praising the draft without checking the disputed quotation.
takeaways.zh: 編輯說，精確更正可比許多未查爭議引文便讚好初稿的網上聲音更有分量。

lessons.titleZh: 建立判斷是非的道德方向

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Parents help set the moral compass.

brief.meaningEn: Help establish principles that orient decisions about right and wrong.
brief.meaningZh: 幫助建立用來引導是非判斷的原則。
brief.grammar: parents/examples can help set the moral compass; set is also the past form. Moral compass is ethical orientation, not just practical efficiency or an instruction deciding every case.
brief.boundaryZh: 有方向不等於每次判斷必正確，也不表示此後不能反思；要說哪些原則及具體影響，不只由成人身份假定。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有方向不等於每次判斷必正確，也不表示此後不能反思；要說哪些原則及具體影響，不只由成人身份假定。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「建立判斷是非的道德方向」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: In his account, the adults’ willingness to return an extra payment helped set the moral compass: fairness mattered even when keeping the money would have been convenient, though later choices still required thought.
listening.zh: 在他的敘述裏，成人願意退回多收款項，幫助建立道德方向：即使留下錢較方便，公平仍重要，但之後選擇仍需要思考。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 成人的實際例子支持公平原則，沒有替往後每件事預定答案。
成人只在計算收入，沒有涉及退回多收款項。
留下多收款被當成公平示範，因較方便。
這個例子只改變他算款項的速度，沒有影響後來對公平的考慮。

listening.explanationZh: return extra/fairness 給原則及例子，later thought 保留後續判斷。

reply.promptEn: What ethical direction did the example give him?
reply.promptZh: 那個例子給他甚麼道德方向？

options.en: It helped set the moral compass by showing that fairness mattered even when another choice was convenient.
options.zh: 它展示即使另一選擇方便，公平仍重要，幫助建立道德方向。

options.en: It gave him a concrete reason to consider who was rightfully owed the money.
options.zh: 它給他具體理由，思考款項正當地應歸誰。

options.en: The action made fairness part of how he approached later choices.
options.zh: 那個行動讓公平成為他處理後來選擇的一部分。

options.en: He learned an orienting principle, rather than a ready-made answer to every later problem.
options.zh: 他學到引導原則，不是每個後來問題的現成答案。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 團隊的新規則只按誰最快交稿排名，沒有提準確、署名或公平。宣傳把速度排行直接寫成已建立是非方向。哪句較謹慎？

options.en: A speed ranking alone does not show how the rules set the moral compass; we need to know the ethical principles they establish.
options.zh: 單是速度排名，沒有顯示規則怎樣建立道德方向；需要知道它們確立哪些是非原則。

options.en: The rule already states how accuracy and fair credit should guide the team’s decisions.
options.zh: 規則已說明準確及公平署名應怎樣引導團隊決定。

options.en: The ranking’s efficiency is enough to identify the ethical principles behind it, without any account of fair treatment.
options.zh: 即使未說公平對待，排名有效率也足以確定背後的是非準則。

scene.explanationZh: 速度排行不等於已給出公平原則；也不能由有效率直接補成道德方向已清楚。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 set the moral compass 得出？

options.en: 參與建立判斷是非的方向。
只要安排能提高辦事速度，就已足以說明建立了道德方向。
可進一步說明哪些行動或原則形成作用。

contrast.explanationZh: moral 說明是非準則；提高效率本身不能說明哪些公平或誠實原則引導選擇。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說只要團隊很有效率，就是道德方向已清楚；你想分效率與是非準則。哪句最好？

options.en: Efficiency does not by itself set the moral compass; we also need to say how honesty and fair credit guide the work.
options.zh: 效率本身不建立道德方向；我們也需說誠實及公平署名怎樣引導工作。

options.en: I thought the order of finishing was already enough to tell us how the group handled credit fairly.
options.zh: 我原以為，完成先後足以告訴我們小組怎樣公平處理署名。

options.en: I would compare only the number of completed tasks, not the reasons behind the choices.
options.zh: 我只會比較完成任務數，不看選擇背後的理由。

dialogue.explanationZh: 工作量可有價值，但不能代替道德原則與具體做法。

speaking.en: A shared rule can help set the moral compass if it explains whose interests matter and how the group should handle a mistake.
speaking.zh: 共同規則若說明誰的利益重要、小組應怎樣處理錯誤，就可幫助建立道德方向。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說清共同規則的倫理內容。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你準備訪問家人，做一小段有關是非觀念來源的口述記錄。你不想只收到「做人要好」的標語，想請對方講一件難作選擇的真事，說明考慮過誰的需要及為何決定，不假定一段故事就解釋全部人生。用一至兩句英文提出訪問問題。

examples.en: To understand what helped set the moral compass in our family, could I ask about a difficult choice you remember making? I would like to hear whose needs you considered and why, rather than record only a general rule about being good.
examples.zh: 為了解甚麼幫我們家建立道德方向，我可否問一個你記得的困難選擇？我想聽你考慮過誰的需要及為何決定，而不只記一條做人要好的通則。

examples.en: Which experiences helped set the moral compass you brought to decisions about other people? If you are willing, please tell me one occasion and the reasons you weighed, while leaving room for how your thinking has changed since.
examples.zh: 哪些經驗幫你建立在涉及別人時作決定的道德方向？如果你願意，請講一次情況及當時權衡的理由，也保留後來想法怎樣改變的空間。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出能連到倫理方向的具體經驗與理由問題，尊重自願及後來改變；不只要求空泛標語，也不把單一故事當完整或固定一生的答案。

takeaways.en: The adults’ response to the missing credit helped set the moral compass for the group more clearly than their poster about honesty had done.
takeaways.zh: 成人回應缺署名的方式，比誠實海報更清楚幫小組建立道德方向。

takeaways.en: They wanted the induction to help set the moral compass by discussing a real choice about fairness, not merely listing the deadlines.
takeaways.zh: 他們想迎新透過討論真實公平選擇幫助建立道德方向，不只列期限。
